item.title: Sheriff Says Suspect Tried to Drown K-9 Ghost

item.title: RR CROSSING CLOSURE- FORD ROAD
item.description: Union Pacific Railroad will be performing work to the crossing on Ford Road at 494 starting SUNDAY, 1/11, through WEDNESDAY, 1/14. This will be a total road closure, with traffic detouring through Needham Road and East Martin Road. Follow the detour routes and expect delays in the area.
